# InstaBox for Herdr

Persistent InstaBox cloud machines as native Herdr SSH remotes. Stable plugin ID: v01dstar.instabox. No automatic local checkout upload or patch-back. Plugin auth is separate from the standalone InstaBox CLI.

## Start here
- README.md: installation, first run, multiple-account overview
- docs/authentication.md: root environment, providers, profiles, identity/workspace policy
- docs/configuration.md: strict JSON configuration reference
- docs/usage.md: lifecycle and shortcuts
- examples/README.md: copyable configurations and full workflows
- docs/troubleshooting.md: diagnostics and recovery
- docs/design.md: architecture and source map
- docs/verification.md: offline versus live verification
- CONTRIBUTING.md: development and invariants
- SECURITY.md: trust boundaries and sensitive reports

Prefer explicit --account NAME in scripts. Never print credentials or bypass identity guards. Before retrying an interrupted create/copy, inspect remote state. Closing settings or logging out does not stop cloud billing.
